newsitem.title: GERMANY: German regulator launches derivatives survey.
newsitem.headline: German regulator launches derivatives survey.

text.p: The German Federal Banking Supervisory Office said on Monday it has launched a survey on risk management models used in derivatives trading.

The group said that some 174 banks in Germany have been contacted to participate in the survey which is designed to obtain feedback on banks' use of models to determine and guide risk while dealing with derivatives.
Results are designed to give the Supervisory Office as well as the Bundesbank a better overview of the models used and their stages of development, the group said.
The results may also help regulators determine the amount of equity capital banks must hold while conducting derivatives business.
